strings.sys.journal.person.maria.name: Maria Gorelowa
strings.sys.journal.person.maria.note: Came back from Veltrava in January in wagon 24 318. Shovels coal in Column 4 until the screening is done. Scratched “We are fourteen” into the wall.
strings.sys.journal.person.hanna.name: Hanna Adler
strings.sys.journal.person.hanna.note: My sister. Teacher, Kolonnenstraße 14, side wing. Lets Ilse into the classroom before lessons and doesn’t ask who is looking for her.
strings.sys.journal.person.wendt.name: Kommissar Ludwig Wendt
strings.sys.journal.person.wendt.note: State Police. Signed the pneumatic-post slip. Speaks softly, forgets nothing and is always out and about on Tuesdays.
strings.sys.journal.person.blockwart.name: Erwin Kuhnert
strings.sys.journal.person.blockwart.note: Caretaker and block warden in Hanna’s building. Keeps the household card index, one card per flat. Order is his word for fear.
